description: Index of shipped portrait assets in res://assets/portraits/. Naming: ethnicity_class_gender_number (ethnicity may be the two-token 'greco_roman'). 'class' is normalized to match class_id (hyphens -> underscores). Used by the portrait picker to resolve and filter portraits by class in exported builds where DirAccess cannot scan res://. User portraits are additionally scanned from user://portraits/ at runtime.
